spotlight.title: Spotlight: Featured Cards
spotlight.note: Cards in bold have a particularly high adoption rate within their category.
spotlight.cat0_desc: Cards expected to be highly effective, especially in critical late-game situations like Act 4 boss battles.
spotlight.cat1_desc: Cards with exceptionally high tendency scores in both attack and defense or with silver/gold medals, expected to perform consistently well.
spotlight.cat2_desc: Cards with high-return potential on offense, accepting a manageable defensive risk.
spotlight.cat3_desc: Cards that excel at stabilizing combat by providing strong defense, accepting a manageable offensive risk.
spotlight.cat4_desc: Cards that may seem weak at first glance but have the potential for unexpected success under specific conditions.
spotlight.cat5_desc: Well-rounded cards that improve deck stability by balancing offense and defense.
spotlight.criteria_desc: Each card is evaluated based on the following conditions. Tendency scores range from -2.5 to 2.5, with ☆ for >=0.5 and ⭐ for >=0.75.
spotlight.star_cond1: Overall performance is below average, but has a highlight in the Act 4 boss battle.
spotlight.star_cond2: Has a medal, and all highlights are concentrated in Act 3 or later.
spotlight.star_cond3: Attack or Defense Tendency score exceeds 1.0.
spotlight.honor_cond1: Has a Gold or Silver medal.
spotlight.honor_cond2: Both Attack and Defense Tendencies are > 0.25, with one being > 0.75.
spotlight.honor_cond3: Has a Bronze medal or better, both tendencies > 0.25, and one > 0.5.
spotlight.honor_cond4: Sum of tendency scores is >= 0.75 with a medal, and overall performance is above average.
spotlight.balancer_cond1: Both Attack and Defense Tendencies are positive, and their sum is >= 0.5.
spotlight.high_roller_cond1: Attack Tendency is >= 0.25, and Defense Tendency is between -0.75 and 0.25.
spotlight.solid_defender_cond1: Defense Tendency is >= 0.25, and Attack Tendency is between -0.75 and 0.25.
spotlight.counter_cond1: Sum of tendency scores is < -1, and has a medal.

deck_diagnosis.title: Similar Run Search
deck_diagnosis.note: ⚠️ Similarity is a possession-based Jaccard index (compared against each run's final deck). It is not a statistical estimate — "results of players with similar decks" show correlation, not causation. Use it as a reference for decision-making.
deck_diagnosis.load_error: Failed to load similar-run search data:
deck_diagnosis.ph_card: Card name (Japanese/English) → Add button or Enter
deck_diagnosis.metric_note:
Both measures are based on card possession (copies ignored). Jaccard = overlap of both whole decks (larger decks are harder to match). Containment = how much of your deck is contained in each run's final deck (higher with smaller decks, so even a starter deck + 1 card can be judged). Threshold-based populations use the selected measure.
If exhibits are entered with the checkbox ON, cards and exhibits are pooled into one set for the similarity calculation (exhibits strongly reflect build archetypes, which improves accuracy).
Items marked with 📌 are always included — they always count toward the similarity (even if they are starter cards), and only runs that have ALL pinned items become pool candidates.

metric_info.title: How it is calculated
metric_info.more: Read more in the How-to tab
metric_info.prate_def: A rating of **pick strength** computed Elo-style, by treating each pick as a duel between the two cards offered in the same cell. **1000 = overall average**.
metric_info.prate_note: This is not raw combat performance (Attack/Defense perf.) but **how often the card wins picks**. Cards never offered alongside another card have no rating. Ratings are computed per character, so they are not directly comparable across characters.
metric_info.deci_def: The denominator of the draft win rate: the number of duels where either card was actually chosen.
metric_info.deci_note: Skipped cells are not counted (duel-level aggregation).
metric_info.draft_def: How often this card won when it was offered head-to-head against another card in the same cell.
metric_info.draft_note: If three or more cards appear in one cell, that cell counts as multiple duels. The denominator differs from Pick rate (per offered cell).
metric_info.offers_def: How many times this card was offered in shops or events (per cell).
metric_info.offers_note: Shelves you could not afford are still counted as offers.
metric_info.availn_def: The part of the offering count where the card was actually selectable. For shops, only purchases or shelves affordable with the displayed gold count.
metric_info.availn_note: The difference from Offering count is the number of shelves you could not afford.
metric_info.pickrate_def: The share of offered cells where this card was chosen (per cell, including skips).
metric_info.pickrate_note: Breakdown: chosen {w} / lost (another card was chosen) {l} / skipped {s}.
metric_info.adopt_def: The share of runs in which this card was acquired at least once (based on Cards_log Add).
metric_info.adopt_note: Cards consumed on use still count as acquired. The gap to Final adoption is what disappeared or was removed later.
metric_info.final_def: The share of runs where the card is still in the deck at the end (same definition as Adoption on the Card List tab).
metric_info.final_note: A large gap from Real adoption means the card is "taken but not kept".
metric_info.score_def: A single score combining **pick strength** (P-rate) and stackability (2+ copies rate).
metric_info.score_note: 1.0 = average. Cards that are stacked in multiples score higher.
metric_info.avg_def: The average number of copies acquired in runs that took this card.
metric_info.avg_f: Total copies ÷ runs with acquisition = **{avg} copies**
metric_info.pct2_def: The share of runs that acquired two or more copies of this card.
metric_info.pct2_f: Runs with 2+ copies ÷ runs with acquisition = **{pct}**
metric_info.pct2_note: Higher means the card is stacked rather than taken once.
metric_info.fpk_def: The share of offered cells where this card was chosen as the first option.
metric_info.fpk_note: High = popular as an early pick. Same definition as First-pick rate on the Card List tab.
metric_info.au_def: How much, on average, acquired copies of this card were upgraded.
metric_info.au_note: Cards with more upgrade sources score higher.
metric_info.flow_def: Pick rate by offering order within a single run: 1st, 2nd, 3rd and later offers.
metric_info.flow_f: Cells show picks / offers, e.g. 2nd offer 50% (30/60)
metric_info.flow_note: Cards that become less attractive after the first copy show a drop here.
metric_info.actpick_def: Pick rate per Act, split into not-owned and already-owned cases.
metric_info.actpick_f: n in each cell = picks / offers
metric_info.actpick_note: Cards that improve late (Act 3) are the "slow-burn" type.
metric_info.atk_def: Damage dealt per battle, expressed as a deviation score. **50 = average**; higher is stronger.
metric_info.atk_note: Estimated from battles in runs that adopted this card.
metric_info.defperf_def: How little damage was taken per battle, expressed as a deviation score. **50 = average**.
metric_info.defperf_note: Attack perf. plus Defense perf. makes the Perf column.
metric_info.perf_def: The Perf column of the Top 40 on the Card Performance tab = Attack perf. + Defense perf.
metric_info.perf_note: A card that is strong on only one side looks average in the total.
metric_info.stab_def: How small the variance of battle results is. Higher means more consistent performance.
metric_info.stab_note: With the same average, a less stable card has bigger highs and lows.
metric_info.gap_def: How many times the actual final adoption compares with the share expected from first offers. **Closer to 1.0 = the card stays from the first offer to the end of the run.**
metric_info.gap_note: 1.2 or more = skipped at first but valued later / below 0.8 = picked early but often dropped later. Starter cards cannot be measured and are shown as N/A.
metric_info.sample_def: The number of runs used to compute this card's statistics.
metric_info.sample_note: Cards with few runs have noisier numbers.
metric_info.jaccard_def: Deck overlap: shared cards ÷ cards in either deck.
metric_info.jaccard_note: Copies are ignored; only the set of card types is compared.
metric_info.coverage_def: How much of your deck is contained in the other deck.
metric_info.coverage_note: Can reach 100% even when the other deck is much larger.
metric_info.tpf_def: Average number of turns per battle.
metric_info.tpf_note: Shorter means aggro; longer means a grindier plan.
metric_info.lpf_note: Smaller means damage is better controlled.
metric_info.encrate_def: The share of runs in the pool that fought this enemy.
metric_info.encrate_note: Rare enemies have fewer samples, so their numbers are noisier.
